justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/stmt/*.java` (25 classes, 5,262 LOC total), plus `Statement.java`, `BlockStmt.java`, `SwitchStmt.java`, `TryStmt.java`, `ForStmt.java`, `IfStmt.java`, `SwitchEntry.java`, `LocalRecordDeclarationStmt.java`, and `UnparsableStmt.java`. The package is sizeable, but it is coherently partitioned into one class per statement kind; the largest files are `Statement.java` (488 LOC, shared base/type-casting helpers), `SwitchEntry.java` (380), `TryStmt.java` (323), `ForStmt.java` (299), and `IfStmt.java` (261). This indicates a focused AST subpackage rather than a package centralizing unrelated responsibilities, so the God Component smell is not present.
